description: This bar chart, titled "Accuracy by different attributes on multi-retrieval task (n=2)", illustrates the accuracy scores for four distinct attributes—city, hobby, university, major, and birthdate—across three different model configurations: Qwen2.5-7b-1M, InternLM3-8b, and Qwen2.5-7b. The horizontal axis presents these three model configurations as categorical labels, while the vertical axis represents accuracy scores on a linear scale ranging from 0 to 100, with tick marks at intervals of 20. Each model configuration is represented by a group of five adjacent bars, each corresponding to one of the five attributes and colored differently according to the legend: city (teal), hobby (orange), university (blue), major (pink), and birthdate (green). For Qwen2.5-7b-1M, the accuracy values are approximately 90 for city, 90 for hobby, 90 for university, 90 for major, and 90 for birthdate. For InternLM3-8b, the values are approximately 70 for city, 80 for hobby, 50 for university, 70 for major, and 90 for birthdate. For Qwen2.5-7b, the values are approximately 2 for city, 3 for hobby, 3 for university, 3 for major, and 15 for birthdate. The bars are not sorted; they appear in the order specified by the legend. The Qwen2.5-7b model configuration has a gray background shading behind its bars, visually distinguishing it from the other two model groups.
